patch.summary: AppDynamics cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: AppDynamics pricing is plan-gated. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: AppDynamics cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price AppDynamics against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, infrastructure monitoring, APM and distributed tracing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6). Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
